name: Aegis Command Palette
description: Keyboard-driven omnibar for rapid tier navigation, cell actions, and tool invocation.

clean-active-url.description: Clean tracking parameters from active tab URL

notes: Permission justification: commands is required to register global keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+Shift+P); tabs is required to query the active tab for contextual actions (e.g. cleaning active URL or auditing tab posture); storage is used for user preference and kill-switch state persistence. Strictly least privilege: does NOT request host permissions (<all_urls>), webRequest, or network access. Operates 100% locally and offline (Privacy Class P0).
